nodes.label: HonoBackend
nodes.rationale: Wraps Hono, the ultra-light runtime-agnostic framework. Right when edge/serverless or cross-runtime portability is a hard requirement; for a typical long-running production server Fastify is usually preferable.

nodes.label: Runtime-agnostic HTTP
nodes.rationale: The same code runs on Bun, Node, Deno, Cloudflare Workers, AWS Lambda and Vercel; getApp() exposes the underlying Hono instance for export to an edge runtime's fetch handler.

nodes.label: Edge runtime caveats
nodes.rationale: Edge isolates are per-request, so in-memory actor state does not survive between requests; outbound TCP is unavailable so cluster join fails; and wall-clock timeouts (30 s on Cloudflare) rule out long-running actors. Use actor-ts as a library inside the request lifecycle only - never for clustered, persistent systems.
